# SpinfoSecurity ICS/OT Advisories

> Aggregated CISA industrial control (ICSA) and medical device (ICSMA) advisories for OT/ICS equipment maintainers.

This site is generated from the official CISA CSAF OT feed. Always verify remediation details on the linked CISA advisory page.

## Primary pages

- [Advisories triage UI](https://spinfosecurity.github.io/ics-ot-advisories/): searchable list with severity filters
- [RSS feed](https://spinfosecurity.github.io/ics-ot-advisories/feed.xml): machine subscribe
- [JSON snapshot](https://spinfosecurity.github.io/ics-ot-advisories/advisories.json): structured recent advisories
- [Source repository](https://github.com/spinfosecurity/ics-ot-advisories): aggregator code and docs
- [Portfolio](https://spinfosecurity.github.io/): SpinfoSecurity OT/ICS defensive tooling
- [Attribution](https://github.com/spinfosecurity/ics-ot-advisories/blob/main/ATTRIBUTION.md): source and limits

## Optional

- [FOR-EMPLOYERS.md](https://github.com/spinfosecurity/ics-ot-advisories/blob/main/FOR-EMPLOYERS.md): hiring-manager review map
- [ICS OT Protector](https://github.com/spinfosecurity/ics-ot-protector): companion exposure scanners
